project_description: Private beta voice coaching app that helps users discover unconscious speaking habits through real-time feedback, with light diagnostics to differentiate from competitors
core_hypothesis: The holy shit moment - Users discover unconscious speaking habits (filler words, pace) they weren't aware of. Value = immediate awareness + root-cause insight (why you struggle), not just skill coaching.
target_users: Friends/family willing to give honest feedback (5-10 testers)
success_metrics: Completion Rate: Do testers finish at least 3 sessions?
Discovery Moment: Do testers report surprise at their filler count or pace?
Return Rate: Do testers come back within 48 hours?
Qualitative: What's the one thing they wish was different?

research_validated.filler_awareness_behavior_change: VALIDATED - 80%+ reduction with awareness training alone. Immediate feedback reduces fillers 50%+. Feedback REDUCES anxiety.
research_validated.visual_feedback_retention: VALIDATED - 3.5x retention with visual gauges/charts (Duolingo case study). Real-time gauge + weekly trend = top priorities.
research_validated.safari_web_speech_api: PROBLEMATIC - 90% accuracy drop, critical bugs. Decision: Chrome-only for beta.
research_validated.filler_detection_accuracy: ASR-based (transcript) = 95%+ F1. Acoustic-only = 75-85% F1. Decision: Hybrid approach.

tasks.title: Project Setup & Scaffolding (Day 1-2)
acceptance_criteria: New project folder created (or Black Swan forked)
Tailwind config updated with High-Performance Clinical theme
Chrome browser detection + warning for non-Chrome browsers
Vercel project created with placeholder deployed

tasks.title: Audio Pipeline + Visual Gauge (Day 3-4)
acceptance_criteria: Real-time filler count GAUGE component (not just numbers)
Mic capture to metrics display loop working

tasks.title: Playback with Filler Highlighting (Day 7-8)
tasks.note: Research-validated: Two-phase awareness (playback + real-time) = most sustained behavior change
acceptance_criteria: Filler timestamps synced to audio timeline
Visual markers on playback timeline showing filler locations
Tap filler marker to jump to that moment

tasks.title: Transcript with Highlights (Day 9-10)
acceptance_criteria: Transcript captured via Web Speech API (Chrome)
Hybrid filler detection: acoustic + transcript reconciliation at session end
Toggle between pace OR filler highlight views (not simultaneous)

tasks.title: Scorecard & AI Summary (Day 11-12)
acceptance_criteria: Metrics summary displays (WPM avg, filler count, filler rate, duration)
Weekly trend chart populated with session data
Any API error = show local stats only (graceful degradation)

tasks.title: Polish & Error Handling (Day 13-14)
acceptance_criteria: UI transitions and loading states polished

tasks.title: Deployment & Beta Prep (Day 15-17)
acceptance_criteria: Tested on Chrome desktop + Chrome mobile

tasks.note: Content track - does not block dev sprint
acceptance_criteria: 3-5 questions selected from Volitional Diagnostic framework
Diagnostic results stored and influence AI summary context
Periodic re-diagnostic trigger logic defined (interval TBD)

tasks.title: [PARALLEL] Privacy Transparency Page
tasks.note: Content track - does not block dev sprint
acceptance_criteria: Explains: no emotion detection, audio processed locally, what Gemini sees
Clear data usage policy (NOT re-used for training)

tasks.title: [PARALLEL] Optional Speaking Prompts
tasks.note: Content track - does not block dev sprint
acceptance_criteria: 1-2 scenarios adapted from Black Swan as optional prompts
UI to select prompt or skip to free practice
Prompts displayed during session if selected

in_beta: Real-time filler count gauge (visual, not just numbers)
Filler word detection (hybrid: acoustic real-time + transcript reconciliation)
Audio playback with filler highlighting (research-validated for behavior change)
Post-session transcript with toggle-able highlights (pace OR fillers)
Light diagnostics (3-5 questions from Volitional framework, onboarding + periodic)
1-2 optional speaking prompts (adapted from Black Swan scenarios)
AI coaching summary (button to generate, post-session only)
Gemini error handling (any API error = show local stats only)

phase2_cost_optimization: Acoustic-only filler detection (reduce Whisper API dependency)

technical_decisions.browser_support: Chrome-only for beta (Safari Web Speech API has 90% accuracy drop + critical bugs)
technical_decisions.filler_detection: Hybrid: acoustic detection real-time + transcript reconciliation at session end
technical_decisions.gemini_fallback: Any API error triggers fallback to local stats only
technical_decisions.silence_handling: Nudge after 10 seconds of no speech detected
technical_decisions.transcript_source: Web Speech API (Chrome) - interim results for real-time, final results for accuracy
technical_decisions.real_time_ai: Post-session only (v2/v3 for real-time coaching during session)
